options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_host
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center hostname.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_port
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center port.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: filterConflictingTemplates
options.description: FilterConflictingTemplates query parameter. Filter template(s) based on confliting templates.

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: latestVersion
options.description: LatestVersion query parameter. LatestVersion flag to get the latest versioned template.

options.name: productFamily
options.description: ProductFamily query parameter. Filter template(s) based on device family.

options.name: productSeries
options.description: ProductSeries query parameter. Filter template(s) based on device series.

options.name: productType
options.description: ProductType query parameter. Filter template(s) based on device type.

options.name: projectId
options.description: ProjectId query parameter. Filter template(s) based on project UUID.

options.name: projectNames
options.description: ProjectNames query parameter. Filter template(s) based on project names.

options.name: softwareType
options.description: SoftwareType query parameter. Filter template(s) based software type.

options.name: softwareVersion
options.description: SoftwareVersion query parameter. Filter template(s) based softwareVersion.

options.name: sortOrder
options.description: SortOrder query parameter. Sort Order Ascending (asc) or Descending (des).

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags query parameter. Filter template(s) based on tags.

options.name: templateId
options.description: TemplateId path parameter. TemplateId(UUID) to get details of the template.

options.name: unCommitted
options.description: UnCommitted query parameter. Filter template(s) based on template commited or not.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
